historical_commentary.text: The debugging tools described here predate 4D's modern integrated debugger, which has evolved significantly with features like remote debugging and the v19+ debugger improvements. The 'quick-and-dirty' debugging tricks reflect an era when 4D's built-in debugging facilities were more limited.
related_updates: 4D's built-in debugger has been substantially enhanced over successive versions
Modern 4D includes integrated debugging with breakpoints, variable inspection, and remote debugging capabilities
